scoreInterpretation: A well-built foundation that's actively improving — both critical issues are already fixed and live, with the biggest trust and content opportunities up next.
takeaways: Your site's technical foundation is strong — clean setup, fast pages, and genuinely rich local content for the areas you serve.
Both critical issues are already resolved and live: the broken “call now” button on coin pages, and the homepage showing “0 years / 0 locations” to search engines.
Eight items in total were fixed and verified live this cycle, including several search-engine and clean-up improvements.
The biggest remaining opportunity is trust and credibility: naming your appraisers, tightening your policies, and backing up claims will lift both rankings and conversions.
The main content work ahead is deepening your coin pages with original descriptions and your own imagery.

progress.summary: Strong progress since the initial review: 8 of the 42 findings are resolved and verified live — including both critical fixes. 34 items remain, prioritized below.

resolved.title: The “call now” button on your coin pages now works
resolved.meaning: This button is the primary way visitors call you from your busiest product pages, and it was leading to an error instead of dialing.
resolved.action: We fixed the broken link so every coin page now has a working one-tap call button, and confirmed calls are tracked — deployed and verified live on 2026-07-15.

resolved.title: Homepage now shows your real experience and store count
resolved.meaning: Search engines and early-loading visitors were briefly seeing “0 years in business” and “0 locations,” which undercut trust at first impression.
resolved.action: We made those numbers render correctly from the first moment the page loads — deployed and verified live on 2026-07-15.

resolved.title: Coin product pages are now findable by search engines
resolved.meaning: Your coin pages weren't being submitted to search engines, so they were far less likely to be discovered and ranked.
resolved.action: We added all coin product pages to the sitemap so search engines can find and index them — deployed and verified live on 2026-07-15.

resolved.title: Silver coin pages now show the correct category
resolved.meaning: Every silver coin page was mislabeled as “Gold Coins,” which confused visitors and search engines.
resolved.action: We corrected the category labels so each page reads accurately — deployed and verified live on 2026-07-15.

resolved.title: Removed the self-referential review rating search engines flag
resolved.meaning: A site-wide star-rating marker repeated your own rating in a way that search engines discount and can penalize.
resolved.action: We removed it, keeping only the legitimate per-store ratings — deployed and verified live on 2026-07-15.

resolved.title: Removed mentions of services you no longer offer
resolved.meaning: Some pages still referenced electronics buying and an inactive gold calculator, which set wrong expectations.
resolved.action: We cleaned up the copy so the site reflects only what you offer today — deployed and verified live on 2026-07-15.

resolved.title: Homepage product cards now lead to the right pages
resolved.meaning: The “what you can sell” cards on the homepage all pointed to a generic list instead of the matching service page.
resolved.action: We linked each card directly to its service page for a smoother path to enquiry — deployed and verified live on 2026-07-15.

resolved.title: Redirected outdated legacy web addresses
resolved.meaning: Old addresses from the previous site were leading visitors and search engines to dead ends.
resolved.action: We redirected the genuine legacy pages to their current equivalents and made the store-finder page eligible to appear in search — deployed and verified live on 2026-07-15.

high.title: Your privacy policy doesn't match how the website actually works
high.meaning: The stated policy describes data practices that don't reflect the live site, which is a compliance risk under Virginia's consumer data law and can erode trust.
high.action: We'll rewrite the privacy policy to accurately describe what's collected, with a legal review before it goes live.

high.title: Your coin pages are thin and rely on competitor-sourced photos
high.meaning: Many product pages carry little unique text and use images and wording pulled from another company — which limits how well they rank and creates a copyright risk.
high.action: We'll add original, useful descriptions to each page and replace the borrowed imagery with your own.

high.title: No named experts or credentials appear anywhere on the site
high.meaning: For a business handling valuables, showing who does the appraising — with real experience and credentials — is one of the strongest drivers of both search rankings and customer confidence.
high.action: We'll add appraiser bios and verifiable credentials/licensing so visitors and search engines see the expertise behind the business.

high.title: Two pages compete for the same search, so neither ranks at its best
high.meaning: Your Northern Virginia landing page and a related page target the same query, splitting their strength instead of combining it.
high.action: We'll consolidate them into one strong page and adjust titles so each page targets a distinct search.

high.title: Your visitor tracking can be skewed and under-counts real calls
high.meaning: The measurement setup lets automated traffic in and misses or double-counts some actions, so the numbers you're basing decisions on aren't fully reliable.
high.action: We'll add safeguards and fix the event tracking so your reporting reflects real customer activity.

high.title: A few accessibility barriers could exclude some visitors
high.meaning: Low-contrast text and some keyboard-navigation gaps make parts of the site harder to use for people with disabilities — both a usability and a legal-exposure issue.
high.action: We'll fix the contrast and keyboard issues to meet accessibility standards.

polish.title: Give each store page more local detail
polish.meaning: The four store pages are currently the thinnest in your local set, missing an opportunity to rank for neighborhood searches.
polish.action: We'll add unique, location-specific content to each store page.

polish.title: Standardize your founding year across the site
polish.meaning: Different pages state different founding years, which reads as careless and can weaken trust.
polish.action: We'll confirm the correct year with you and make it consistent everywhere.

polish.title: Back up blog claims with trusted sources
polish.meaning: Your guides make claims about gold and value without linking to authoritative references, which limits their credibility with readers and search engines.
polish.action: We'll add reputable citations to the key articles.

polish.title: Refresh a few outdated legacy pages still showing in search
polish.meaning: Search engines still surface some old pages from years ago that have since been replaced, which can send visitors to the wrong place.
polish.action: We'll request a refresh from the search engines so the current pages take their place.

strengths: A clean, correct search-engine setup — canonical URLs and a disciplined redirect map with no broken chains.
21 genuinely rich, unique local pages for the cities and neighborhoods you serve.
A fast, image-optimized site built for performance from the ground up.
Consistent store name, address, and phone details across the entire site.
Privacy consent handling already in place for visitors in regulated regions.
nextSteps: Strengthen trust: rewrite the privacy policy, add named appraisers and credentials, and make tracking reliable.
Deepen content: original coin descriptions with your own imagery, plus richer store pages.
Resolve overlapping pages so each one targets a distinct search.
Clear the accessibility barriers to meet current standards.
Polish performance and refresh the outdated legacy pages still appearing in search.
